+        publisher = wo_b_publish.WoBPublisher(hidden=5120, hc_mult=4, top_k=6)
+        with (
+            patch.dict(sys.modules, fakes),
+            patch.object(mxfp8_linear, "pinned_tactics", pins),
+        ):
+            publisher._build(wo_b)
+        self.assertEqual(state["seen"], [(n, True) for n in range(1, 9)])
+        self.assertEqual(
+            all_reduce.call_args.kwargs,
+            dict(
+                hidden_size=5120,
+                hc_mult=4,
+                max_num_tokens=switch.WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS,
+                top_k=6,
+                device="cuda:0",
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class TestLayerPublish(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_publishes_only_when_the_layer_defers_the_sum(self):
+        publisher = MagicMock()
+        publisher.publish.return_value = "rows"
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(defers_attn_sum=lambda rows: rows <= 6)
+        with patch.object(wo_b_publish, "_publisher", publisher):
+            bound = wo_b_publish._LayerPublish(layer)
+            self.assertEqual(bound("wo_b", torch.zeros(6, 8)), "rows")
+            # A quantized input counts the rows of its values.
+            x = (torch.zeros(6, 8), torch.zeros(6))
+            self.assertEqual(bound("wo_b", x), "rows")
+            self.assertIsNone(bound("wo_b", torch.zeros(9, 8)))
+        self.assertEqual(publisher.publish.call_count, 2)
+
+    def test_install_shares_one_publisher_without_a_module_cycle(self):
+        def layer(hidden):
+            layer = torch.nn.Module()
+            layer.self_attn = torch.nn.Module()
+            layer.hc_cfg = SimpleNamespace(hidden=hidden, mult=4)
+            layer.config = SimpleNamespace(num_experts_per_tok=6)
+            return layer
+
+        layers = [layer(5120), layer(5120)]
+        with patch.object(wo_b_publish, "_publisher", None):
+            for each in layers:
+                wo_b_publish.install(each)
+            shared = wo_b_publish._publisher
+        self.assertEqual((shared._hidden, shared._hc_mult, shared._top_k), (5120, 4, 6))
+        for each in layers:
+            self.assertIsInstance(
+                each.self_attn.wo_b_publish, wo_b_publish._LayerPublish
+            )
+            # A Module-valued attribute would make the layer its attention's child.
+            self.assertEqual(len(list(each.modules())), 2)
+
+    def test_take_without_a_publisher(self):
+        with patch.object(wo_b_publish, "_publisher", None):
+            self.assertFalse(wo_b_publish.take(torch.zeros(2, 8)))
+
+
+class TestRunAttnPost(CustomTestCase):
+    def _run(self, publisher, partial):
+        rows = 2
+        residual = torch.randn(rows, 4, 8)
+        triplet = (torch.rand(rows, 4), torch.rand(rows, 4), torch.rand(rows, 4, 4))
+        norm = SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(8)), variance_epsilon=1e-6
+        )
+        jit = MagicMock(
+            return_value=(None, torch.zeros(rows, 4, 8), torch.zeros(rows, 8))
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(wo_b_publish, "_publisher", publisher),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce_mhc."
+                "all_reduce_mhc_post_combine_norm",
+                jit,
+            ),
+        ):
+            state = mhc.run_attn_post(
+                SimpleNamespace(cfg=_CFG),
+                mhc.AttnOutput(partial),
+                residual,
+                stats_stream=None,
+                next=SimpleNamespace(norm=norm),
+                world_size=4,
+                precomputed=triplet,
+            )
+        return state, jit, triplet, residual
+
+    def test_published_rows_launch_only_the_consumer(self):
+        publisher = _publisher()
+        with _eager():
+            partial = publisher.publish("wo_b", torch.zeros(2, 8))
+        state, jit, (pre, post, comb), residual = self._run(publisher, partial)
+        jit.assert_not_called()
+        consumer = publisher._all_reduce
+        args = consumer.call_args.args
+        self.assertIs(args[0], partial)
+        self.assertIs(args[1], residual)
+        self.assertIs(args[2], post)
+        self.assertIs(args[3], comb)
+        self.assertIs(args[4], pre)
+        self.assertFalse(args[5].requires_grad)
+        self.assertIs(state.streams, consumer.return_value[0])
+        self.assertIs(state.input.rows, consumer.return_value[1])
+        self.assertFalse(publisher.take(partial))
+
+    def test_unpublished_rows_keep_the_jit_kernel(self):
+        for publisher in (None, _publisher()):
+            with self.subTest(publisher=publisher is not None):
+                state, jit, _, _ = self._run(publisher, torch.zeros(2, 8))
+                jit.assert_called_once()
+                self.assertIs(state.streams, jit.return_value[1])
+                if publisher is not None:
+                    publisher._all_reduce.assert_not_called()
+

+class TestProjectWoB(CustomTestCase):

+        attention.wo_b = MagicMock(return_value=(torch.ones(2, 8), None))
+        attention.wo_b.reduce_results = True

+        publish = MagicMock(return_value=rows)
+        attention = self._attention(publish)
+        out = self._project(attention)
+        self.assertIsInstance(out, mhc.AttnOutput)
+        self.assertIs(out.partial, rows)
+        self.assertEqual(publish.call_args.args[1].shape, (2, 8))
+        attention.wo_b.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_declined_runs_wo_b_without_its_sum(self):
+        attention = self._attention(MagicMock(return_value=None))
+        out = self._project(attention)
+        self.assertIsInstance(out, mhc.AttnOutput)
+        attention.wo_b.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertTrue(attention.wo_b.call_args.kwargs["skip_all_reduce"])
+
+    def test_not_deferred_never_publishes(self):
+        publish = MagicMock()
+        out = self._project(self._attention(publish), defer=False)
+        self.assertIsInstance(out, torch.Tensor)
+        publish.assert_not_called()
+

+    unittest.main()

+"""--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode: the deployment check names every unmet
+requirement, and the row bounds stay where they were measured."""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import switch
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import override_platform
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# (field, value that breaks it, a phrase of the requirement it breaks)
+_BREAKS = (
+    ("tp_size", 8, "--tp-size 4"),
+    ("ep_size", 4, "--ep-size 1"),
+    ("moe_a2a_backend", "deepep", "--moe-a2a-backend none"),
+    ("pp_size", 2, "pipeline parallelism"),
+    ("attn_dp_size", 4, "DP attention"),
+    ("attn_cp_size", 2, "context parallelism"),
+    ("nnodes", 2, "one node"),
+    ("speculative_algorithm", "EAGLE", "DSPARK"),
+    ("dsv4_attn_backend", "trtllm", "attention backend"),
+    ("disable_cuda_graph", True, "decode CUDA graphs"),
+    ("enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay", True, "encoder SWA"),
+    ("enable_decoder_swa_bounded_replay", True, "decoder SWA"),
+    ("enable_two_batch_overlap", True, "two-batch overlap"),
+    ("disaggregation_mode", "decode", "PD disaggregation"),
+    ("enable_lora", True, "LoRA"),
+    ("enable_deterministic_inference", True, "deterministic"),
+    ("enable_fp32_lm_head", True, "--enable-fp32-lm-head"),
+    ("rl_on_policy_target", "fsdp", "--rl-on-policy-target"),
+)
+
+
+def _validated(**overrides):
+    cfg = SimpleNamespace(
+        tp_size=4,
+        ep_size=1,
+        moe_a2a_backend="none",
+        pp_size=1,
+        attn_dp_size=1,
+        attn_cp_size=1,
+        nnodes=1,
+        speculative_algorithm="DSPARK",
+        dsv4_attn_backend="auto",
+        disable_cuda_graph=False,
+        cuda_graph_config=SimpleNamespace(decode=SimpleNamespace(backend="full")),
+        enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay=False,
+        enable_decoder_swa_bounded_replay=False,
+        enable_two_batch_overlap=False,
+        disaggregation_mode="null",
+        enable_lora=None,
+        enable_fp32_lm_head=False,
+        rl_on_policy_target=None,
+        enable_deterministic_inference=False,
+    )
+    for name, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(cfg, name, value)
+    return cfg
+
+
+class TestDeploymentCheck(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        # The fake args are their own resolving view; DP attention reads one field.
+        for patcher in (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides.resolving_view",
+                side_effect=lambda a: a,
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.runtime_context.attn_dp_enabled_of",
+                side_effect=lambda cfg: cfg.attn_dp_size > 1,
+            ),
+            override_platform(is_cuda=True, device_sm=103),
+        ):
+            patcher.__enter__()
+            self.addCleanup(patcher.__exit__, None, None, None)
+
+    def test_validated_deployment_passes(self):
+        self.assertEqual(switch.deployment_violations(_validated(), "deepseek_v41"), [])
+        for backend in ("auto", "flashmla"):
+            cfg = _validated(dsv4_attn_backend=backend)
+            switch.check_deployment(cfg, "deepseek_v41")
+
+    def test_each_requirement_is_checked_on_its_own(self):
+        for field, value, phrase in _BREAKS:
+            with self.subTest(field=field):
+                violations = switch.deployment_violations(
+                    _validated(**{field: value}), "deepseek_v41"
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(len(violations), 1, violations)
+                self.assertIn(phrase, violations[0])
+        graphs_off = SimpleNamespace(decode=SimpleNamespace(backend="disabled"))
+        violations = switch.deployment_violations(
+            _validated(cuda_graph_config=graphs_off), "deepseek_v41"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(len(violations), 1)
+        self.assertIn("decode CUDA graphs", violations[0])
+
+    def test_model_and_gpu_are_checked(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            len(switch.deployment_violations(_validated(), "deepseek_v4")), 1
+        )
+        # GB200 / B200 (SM100) are not the validated GPU.
+        with override_platform(device_sm=100):
+            violations = switch.deployment_violations(_validated(), "deepseek_v41")
+        self.assertEqual(len(violations), 1)
+        self.assertIn("SM103", violations[0])
+
+    def test_check_names_every_violation_in_one_error(self):
+        cfg = _validated(**{field: value for field, value, _ in _BREAKS})
+        with override_platform(is_cuda=False):
+            violations = switch.deployment_violations(cfg, "deepseek_v4")
+            # Every row of _BREAKS, the model and the GPU.
+            self.assertEqual(len(violations), len(_BREAKS) + 2)
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as raised:
+                switch.check_deployment(cfg, "deepseek_v4")
+        message = str(raised.exception)
+        self.assertIn("--enable-dsv41-low-latency-decode", message)
+        for violation in violations:
+            self.assertIn(violation, message)
+
+
+class TestRowBounds(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_measured_bounds(self):
+        # Measured on GB300 (see switch.py); change them only with new measurements.
+        self.assertEqual(switch.MXFP8_MAX_ROWS, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(switch.LOW_M_BF16_MAX_ROWS, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(switch.ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS, 48)
+        self.assertEqual(switch.SWAPAB_MAX_ROWS, 24)
+        self.assertEqual(switch.LM_HEAD_MAX_ROWS, 16)
+
+    def test_bounds_fit_their_kernels(self):
+        from sglang.srt.models.dsv41_low_latency import routed_expert_gemm
+
+        # RoutedExpertGemm rejects a bound outside the route kernels' range.
+        self.assertTrue(
+            routed_expert_gemm.MAX_ROWS
+            <= switch.ROUTED_EXPERT_MAX_ROWS
+            <= routed_expert_gemm.WIDE_MAX_ROWS
+        )
+        # The wo_b mailbox (sized by WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS) must hold every row wo_b publishes.
+        self.assertLessEqual(switch.MXFP8_MAX_ROWS, switch.WO_B_MAILBOX_MAX_TOKENS)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
